cases.description: Try Another on one phrase is a new batch of one window.
The most windows one batch holds.
A sixth window would evict the first window's quotes from the client: refused.
Windows that overlap: refused.
Windows that touch, which placeAll would have merged: refused.
Windows not in source order: refused.
Windows for two voice records: refused.
Windows in two languages: refused.
Windows on two models: refused.
Windows over two sources: refused.
Window 1 runs all three takes; window 2 stops early after its first take and discards takes 2 and 3; window 3 runs on, its first take failing the speaker check before QA.
A take the provider refused (a 500) is not sent and not recorded; the next take fits and stops the window early.
A fatal end (such as a 401) on window 1 ends the batch: windows 2 and 3 are discarded unsent, and nothing can finish after it.
Stop during window 2 keeps what was sent and discards the rest of the batch.
An edit to the scope invalidates window 3 before it sends anything.
Window 2 cannot finish before window 1, and a window cannot report more takes than it has.
